definition: new blocking + K=200 + retrained model + corrected complete-ground-truth validation + independently tuned threshold
changes_vs_v2: blocking token selection: rarest tokens that survive the S2/S3 doc-frequency filter (v2: COALESCE(df,0) ranking, absent tokens counted as rarest)
blocking ranking: idf_same DESC, idf_all DESC, hash tie-break (v2: shared_tokens DESC, candidate_entity_id alphabetical)
K: 200 (v2: 50); candidate_rank stored so K=50/100 can be cut from the same candidate set
model: retrained on candidates from the new blocker; 8M deterministic hash-sampled negatives; fixed 50k-entity holdout excluded from training and TF-IDF fit
validation: all candidates of holdout entities, complete ground truth (blocked-away true matches = false negatives)
threshold: tuned on that validation (v2: 0.96 chosen on the phase-1 realistic holdout)

decomposition_artifacts.candidate_quality_and_classifier: val_k_decomposition.csv (v3 model vs v1 model on identical holdout candidates, K=50/100/200, at 0.96 and tuned)
decomposition_artifacts.caveat: v1 model likely saw holdout entities in training -> its holdout numbers are optimistic, so the retraining gain is a lower bound
